scenario: [LGRA.9.6.3]: `utc(r.seen)` is a spelling the compiler refuses in favour of the member `r.seen.utc`, with DS_VALIDATE_RETIRED_BUILTIN_SPELLING, not with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_FUNCTION. `utc` is not reserved, so a compiler with no such refusal would report an unknown function and never name the replacement.
rules_ds:
schema R scope logical:
    k: Int key
    seen: Time mutable

rule check:
    R r where utc(r.seen).hour > 8
->
    log info "x"
